title: finding(spec): ChartDrillDownSchema's refusal text for `mode` sends authors to `object-pivot` and `object-metric`, which refuse `drillDown.mode` (objectui#9002, objectui#10685); only `object-data-table` reads it
body:
Filing-gate category: ② a seam defect (class c, guidance that points the wrong way): a published refusal sentence names blocks where the key it redirects to is itself refused. Reader: triage first (route and grade; `domain:spec` expected), then the seat that claims it.

Filed by the objectui `domain:ui` execution seat 2 (session `session_014mXUNuFomfj24w7s1pZzhN`) from the objectui#10685 dev report (PR objectstack-ai/objectui#10710), which measured it. ⛔ Not graded and not routed.

## The sentence (objectstack `origin/main` `16c5a33`)

`packages/spec/src/ui/chart.zod.ts:473`, the `guidance` entry for `mode` in `ChartDrillDownSchema`'s strict gate:

> `mode` (`'filter'` | `'record'`) is a TABLE / PIVOT / METRIC drill key, not a chart one: …

`objectui validate` prints it verbatim when an author writes `drillDown.mode` on a chart (measured by the objectui#10685 dev). `packages/spec/src/ui/chart.test.ts:707` pins the phrase (`['mode', 'TABLE / PIVOT / METRIC']`).

## Why it now points the wrong way (objectui side)

- `object-metric` refuses `drillDown.mode` at its TypeScript door since objectui#9002 (PR objectstack-ai/objectui#10681, merged; `ObjectMetricDrillDownConfig.mode?: never`, objectui `packages/types/src/data-display.ts`), on the maintainer ruling recorded on objectstack-ai/objectui#9002 (`5643445104`, B).
- `object-pivot` refuses it at its TypeScript door with objectui#10685 (PR objectstack-ai/objectui#10710, in review).
- Measured by that dev: `object-pivot`'s renderer never read `mode`; only `object-data-table` reads it.

So an author, or an AI, who follows the refusal writes `drillDown.mode` on a pivot or a metric. There TSX is refused, and a stored JSON config is ignored with no diagnostic.

## Direction (for triage, not a ruling)

Name the one block that reads `mode` (`object-data-table`), or drop the list and keep the sentence's reason ("a chart segment is always an aggregate …"), and move the `chart.test.ts:707` pin with it. The neighbouring `report` entry ("a METRIC / PIVOT widget capability") may need the same per-block check. It is not measured here, so ⛔ do not change it on this card's evidence alone.

## Dedupe

objectstack issues and PRs, the 100 most recently created, matched against `ChartDrillDownSchema|TABLE / PIVOT / METRIC|drill.{0,20}mode`: no card carries this sentence. Lit control: the same walk finds objectstack#20141 for `masked`.

Dedupe words: `ChartDrillDownSchema guidance mode` · `TABLE / PIVOT / METRIC drill key` · `chart drill-down unrecognized mode`
